description: This file contains utility methods used across both mobile and wearable parts of the project, including permissions checking, distance formatting, location storage, asset handling for wearables, node querying, and device-specific UI adjustments.

classes.name: Utils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for permissions, distance calculations, location storage, wearable asset handling, node retrieval, and device-specific UI adjustments.

methods.name: checkFineLocationPermission
methods.description: Checks if the application has access to fine location permission; returns true if granted or device is pre-M Android.

methods.name: formatDistanceBetween
methods.description: Calculates the distance between two LatLng points and returns a formatted string with units in meters or kilometers.

methods.name: storeLocation
methods.description: Stores a LatLng location in SharedPreferences.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Retrieves the stored location from SharedPreferences, returns null if unavailable or permission is missing.

methods.name: storeGeofenceEnabled
methods.description: Stores a boolean indicating whether geofence notifications are enabled.

methods.name: getGeofenceEnabled
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean indicating if geofence notifications are enabled.

methods.name: loadBitmapFromAsset
methods.description: Synchronously loads a Bitmap from a wearable Asset; should be called from background thread.

methods.name: createAssetFromBitmap
methods.description: Creates a wearable Asset from a Bitmap.

methods.name: getNodes
methods.description: Returns a collection of IDs of all connected wearable nodes; should be called from background thread.

methods.name: calculateBottomInsetsOnRoundDevice
methods.description: Calculates UI insets for round wearable devices based on display size and system insets.
